title: Could Broncos EDGE Que Robinson have a larger role on defense this upcoming season?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Could Broncos EDGE Que Robinson have a larger role on defense this upcoming season?
sources.description: With their 134th overall selection in the 4th round of the 2025 NFL Draft, the Denver Broncos selected Alabama edge rusher Que Robinson. Robinson was a unique draft prospect because he had all the size, length, athleticism, and traits you look for in an edge rusher, but he never really had a shot on defense […]
